items.name: S.Space
items.tagline: Your team and everyone's AI agents, in one workspace
items.description: Everyone on your team has an AI agent, and none of them work together, so you copy, paste and re-explain all day. S.Space is one workspace for your team and everyone's agents. Bring the ones you already use, like Claude Code and Codex, from any vendor. Agents reach out, hand work to each other and bring you finished results, with shared memory so you explain things once. Agents act, you approve what matters. Free to start. Built by the team behind AutoGen.

items.name: Bluedot Phone Calls
items.tagline: AI note taker for phone calls
items.description: Bluedot now covers phone calls, not just meetings. Dial from the web or mobile app, keep your own caller ID, and get a transcript, summary and action items automatically.

items.name: Toone
items.tagline: Grokbot meets n8n/zapier
items.description: Toone: Grokbot meets n8n/zapier. Build precise agentic workflows and routines in natural language. Each node is an agent's chat thread on the model you pick (ChatGPT or Claude), or an automatic step that runs the same way every time without AI. Run repeatable routines, babysit them with agents, polish as they run, pause and continue anytime. Plus live share, meeting notes, Spotlight-style layouts, Zen Mode, Calendar, Quick Capture, Git, and MCPs for research, SEO and more.

items.name: Waldo by Wherobots
items.tagline: The AI agent that accelerates engineering with spatial data
items.description: Waldo is the geospatial data agent that turns questions about the physical world into answers, maps, and production-ready data pipelines. It analyzes satellite imagery, geometries, geography data, and your organization's first party data, writes and debugs the analysis, and delivers results in hours. When the work needs to run continuously, Waldo turns it into a scheduled pipeline on your existing data platform. Built for spatial analytics at scale by the creators of Apache Sedona.

items.name: Dippr
items.tagline: A data platform served to your agents, with one prompt
items.description: It’s where your agents build and run your company’s software, tools and apps – with access to your company data across sources, the context to understand it, and the rules to use it safely.

items.name: Pitch Avatar HR Suite
items.tagline: Onboarding, training & comms with conversational AI avatars
items.description: HR teams should be talking to people. Instead, up to 70% of the day goes to onboarding, mandatory training, and the same questions again and again, with no way to tell what works. HR Suite automates it with conversational AI avatars. They teach from your materials and answer employees’ questions in lessons and as an HR assistant. Reminders keep people on track; HR sees who finished and where they got stuck. Free 14-day trial + 50% off any plan with code PRODUCTHUNT2026 until Nov 30.

items.name: Mermaid Flow
items.tagline: The visual builder for agentic workflows
items.description: Mermaid Flow lets you build agentic workflows as diagrams, then run them. Think issue triage, weekly recaps, PR reviews: work you'd otherwise hand to a long prompt or a skill file. Describe what you want, start from a template, or bring the file, and you get a workflow with every step laid out. Connect Github, Slack, Notion, and more in one click, then hit run or put it on a schedule. Every run is saved step by step, so you can see what happened and your team can follow along. Free to start.

items.name: dusk bot
items.tagline: free open source Grok bot alternative
items.description: Best free Grok bot alternative. Use the ChatGPT, Claude or Grok plan you already pay for and get a team of bots, each with a job, a memory you can edit and its own computer. They run on a schedule, ask before risky steps, and live in a calm, polished chat app. Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Gemini, Cursor, Copilot, OpenRouter or a local model, on your own sign-in. 100% free and open source

items.name: Review Box
items.tagline: A fast desktop app for reviewing GitHub pull requests
items.description: A fast desktop app for reviewing GitHub pull requests. Track reviewed files, jump to symbol definitions and uses, search the whole PR and ask AI about changes.

items.name: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
items.tagline: Two new OpenAI models: frontier Astra and efficient Sol
items.description: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol are OpenAI’s new models for professional work. Astra is the frontier model for the hardest projects, like slides, websites, 3D designs and science research. Sol is the efficient everyday model for coding and multistep agent work. Per OpenAI, Astra costs under a third per task of GPT-6 Astra. API pricing per million tokens: Astra $8 in, $40 out; Sol $2 in, $10 out. Live in ChatGPT Work and Codex for Plus, Pro, Enterprise and Edu, plus the API.

items.name: Incredible Agents
items.tagline: Fast Voice AI that sees your screen and runs your agents
items.description: The heavily asked for INCREDIBLE AGENTS update is finally here! Your voice can now: (1) CREATE new agents that work directly on your computer, in apps, browsers and files. (2) RUN work on repeat, 24/7. (3) BUILD live sharable pages, dashboards, apps and more. Incredible PROACTIVELY FINDS WORK AI agents can do for you, and sets the agent up. Agents do the work directly on your computer, the way you do, 24/7. FREE TO TRY. Mac and Windows.

items.name: Tencent Hy4 flash
items.tagline: Fast, low-cost model from $0.07/M input
items.description: Hy4 flash is Tencent’s most cost-effective Hy model to date, with 224B total parameters, 12B active, multimodal input and a 1M-token context. Per Tencent, it decodes above 150 tokens per second and costs about $0.07 per million input tokens and $0.28 output. It targets everyday tasks like document work, slides, deep research and computer use, while Hy4 handles harder engineering. Open-sourcing is planned, but the weights are not out yet.

items.name: Replay QA Self-healing Mode
items.tagline: Turn user frustration into verified fixes
items.description: Self-healing Mode turns frustrated user sessions into root-caused bug reports with evidence, sent to your issue tracker or straight to your coding agent. - always-on user session capture (powered by Fullstory) - automatic detection of user frustration signals - Bug reports with detailed root-cause analysis + runtime evidence - pipe them into your issue tracker of choice or straight to your coding agent or factory loop - Daily summary reports of what users did

items.name: UI Verify
items.tagline: Visual testing for coding agents
items.description: UI Verify shows your coding agent every screen its change touched, so the agent catches and fixes its own UI bugs before your users see them. Used by teams at JetBrains, Cura and Metica. Works with Playwright, Storybook, Vitest and Bun, and with iOS and Android apps. Set up in one line. Free to start, and free for open source: 50,000 snapshots a month.

items.name: Arcade
items.tagline: AI video generator for marketing teams
items.description: Arcade is the AI video generator for marketing teams. Describe what you want, answer two questions, and get an on-brand product video in minutes. Start from a prompt, a screen recording, or what you already have in Notion, Linear, Google Drive, GitHub, and Granola. Your Brand Kit, natural voiceover, and every scene editable. Then post straight to YouTube, LinkedIn, and X. Free to start.

items.name: lepoly
items.tagline: One place for all your 3D assets
items.description: lepoly is a digital asset management platform built for 3D. Host, organize, review, and share, all from the browser.

items.name: Introzy
items.tagline: Track referrals from intro to commission
items.description: Track every introduction from handshake to commission. Introzy captures referrals, attributes revenue, and pays partners on time - free to start.

items.name: Polylane for CI
items.tagline: Fix broken builds before they block your team
items.description: When CI fails on main or in your merge queue, Polylane reads the job logs, finds the commit that broke the build, and opens a fix pull request. It runs your build and tests before review, fixes CI failures on its own PRs, and closes the issue when main is green again. Works with GitHub Actions, Depot, and CI that reports checks to GitHub.

items.name: KaDeep AI
items.tagline: Agentic QA, localization & accessibility: know when to ship
items.description: KaDeep Studio Pro is an AI agent that tells you whether a release is ready to ship. Describe a test in plain English and it runs on your web app, iOS or Android build, or desktop app. It localizes 100+ file formats, from app strings and PDFs to Office files, images, SCORM and video, and checks every language in the real build. It audits accessibility under any law: WCAG 2.2, ADA, EAA, Section 508, EN 301 549 and 14 more. Its open-source CLI makes it a go / no-go gate in CI. Free to start.

items.name: Qwen4-Max
items.tagline: Qwen's new flagship for long-running agent work
items.description: Qwen4-Max is the first flagship built on Qwen's new 2.4T-parameter architecture, with native vision and a 1M-token context window. It supports coding, professional workflows, and long-running agent tasks, with API access available now.
